categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in IPTV services, including basic and value-added IPTV businesses, which constitute the main revenue source. It also engages in micro-short drama production and distribution, content services such as copyright operation and marketing, and technical operation services. Additionally, the company is involved in digital applications, smart community services, AI-driven pet care platforms, and immersive media experiences.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including 5G, AI-generated content (AIGC), big data analytics, cloud computing, and ultra-high-definition (UHD) video streaming. It develops proprietary AI algorithms for personalized content recommendation, intelligent media asset management, and automated content creation. The IPTV platform integrates multi-source content and uses virtual private networks for secure transmission. The company also invests in MR/VR immersive experience technologies and AI-powered pet healthcare solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include telecom operators such as China Mobile, China Telecom, and China Unicom in Shandong Province, who distribute IPTV services to end-users. The company serves residential households primarily in Shandong, with IPTV users exceeding 16 million. Other customers include new media platforms (e.g., mobile video, short video apps), cultural content producers, and government or community organizations for smart community projects. The micro-short drama content targets online viewers via platforms like Douyin and WeChat mini-programs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Shandong Province, China, with IPTV services exclusively authorized for this region. It also has activities in Qingdao and Jinan cities, including a micro-short drama production base in Qingdao. While the primary market is domestic, the company is expanding international cultural content dissemination through platforms like YouTube and TikTok.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates at the midstream core of the IPTV industry supply chain as the exclusive operator of the IPTV integrated broadcast control platform in Shandong. It connects upstream content providers and broadcasters with downstream telecom operators and end-users. It also provides content production, copyright management, and technical operation services, positioning itself as a platform operator and service integrator within the digital media ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing IPTV platform capabilities, expanding value-added services, and deepening AI and big data integration for intelligent media operations. The company focuses on developing AI-driven content creation tools, smart community digital platforms, and immersive media technologies. It invests in building a cultural AIGC platform centered on Chinese traditional culture and aims to strengthen international cultural influence. R&D efforts emphasize 5G-based UHD streaming, AI recommendation algorithms, and multi-modal content generation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through IPTV service fees, including basic subscription fees shared with telecom operators and value-added paid content such as movies and specialty channels. Additional income comes from content licensing and copyright revenue sharing with new media platforms, technical service fees for operation support, and micro-short drama pay-per-view or subscription models. The company also earns from government subsidies and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading IPTV operator in Shandong Province with exclusive authorization, positioning it as a dominant regional player. It competes indirectly with other digital media and streaming platforms but benefits from strong government backing and integration with provincial telecom operators. Its strategic focus on AI and cultural content production differentiates it from traditional broadcasters and emerging OTT platforms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 978.7 million, a slight decline of 1.37% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders around RMB 400.3 million, down 2.38%. Total assets grew by 9.24% to RMB 4.21 billion, and net assets increased by 8.17% to RMB 3.71 billion. The company maintains a stable cash flow and invests over 4% of revenue in R&D, reflecting a solid financial scale and a focus on sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its exclusive IPTV platform with integrated broadcast control, offering seamless, user-friendly TV experiences such as 'one remote control, no set-top box' operation. It differentiates through localized content, multi-screen interactive services, and innovative AI-driven personalized recommendations. Its micro-short drama production base and cultural AIGC platform provide unique content assets, while its strong government and telecom partnerships ensure stable market access and policy support.
